references.text: Parallel text describing the fine and expected woman who will also have a bad eye toward her husband and children during the distress of siege.
The warning against having a 'bad eye' toward one's poor brother, using the same expression 'תֵּרַע עֵינְךָ' to describe stinginess and lack of compassion.
Proverbs warns against the one who has a 'bad eye', showing the same attitude of envy and stinginess.
During the siege of Samaria, the people experienced extreme famine that led to cannibalistic acts, fulfilling the curses in Deuteronomy.
Lamentations describes how compassionate women cooked their own children during the siege of Jerusalem, fulfilling the curse in this text.
Jesus uses the expression 'bad eye' to describe envy and stinginess, linking it to the Old Testament concept.
